prompts.name: Verse page — soft paper
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-page desktop website illustration for Quran Universe. Flat front-facing UI, edge to edge, tall portrait canvas approximately 1440 x 2200; show header, complete representative content layout, and footer. No device frame, perspective, photo, people, religious figures, invented logos, decorative landscapes, or floating palette swatches. Light ivory and deep teal design: page #F6F5EF, opaque smooth cream panels #FFFEF9, ink #233735, deep teal #22665E, fine muted gold #B49661, secondary text #62716B. Editorial serif English headings, clean sans-serif UI, beautifully rendered accurate Arabic using supplied text. Restrained thin borders, generous whitespace, delicate eight-point ornaments. Compact navigation at top: "Quran Universe" left; "Quran", "Timeline", "Names of Allah" right. Footer: Quran Universe, "Read with understanding", About, Privacy, Terms. This is a visual design concept; do not invent religious quotations or claims. Use only supplied religious copy, omit extra filler prose. Make all text crisp and readable. Do not apply mesh gradient: that belongs to the homepage only.

PAGE: Al-Fatihah verse 1. Texture: fine natural ivory cotton paper visible in outer margins, absolutely smooth cream reading panels and text surfaces. Quiet scholarly book atmosphere. No glow, grid or distressed parchment.
LAYOUT: single centered reading column about 900 pixels wide. Breadcrumb "Quran / Al-Fatihah / Verse 1". Small heading "Surah Al-Fatihah" and verse reference "1:1". Main spacious cream panel: small gold reference 1:1, largest text is exactly "بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ" centered with generous line spacing. Below it smaller transliteration "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem". Below that elegant English translation exactly "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful." Thin gold separator and closed disclosure row "Word by word" with chevron.
Next separate reflection panel, small label "REFLECTION · DRAFT", serif title "Begin in His name, and the whole thing changes.", subtitle "The opening words of the Opener".
Three small connected boxes labeled "You — about to start" → "His name" → "Merciful, twice".
Two clean editorial sections inside panel:
"Context": "Al-Fatihah was among the very first complete surahs revealed in Makkah. It is called the Mother of the Book, the Opener, and the seven oft-repeated verses."
"Everyday meaning": "You open the laptop for a hard email. You start the car for a long drive. You pick up the phone to call your mother after an argument."
A restrained comparison: subdued crossed-out line "I start things on my own and hope they work out." followed by teal "When I begin in His name, I begin already surrounded by mercy."
Pale teal practice callout "TRY THIS" and exact copy "Before the next task you dread today, pause and say Bismillah slowly, meaning it."
Small note "Simplified reflection. Read the tafsir for scholarship."
Below reflection, closed disclosure "Tafsir Ibn Kathir", then navigation "Back to Al-Fatihah" left and "Next verse · 1:2 →" right. Footer. Small footer concept label "01 · Verse page · Soft paper". Keep typography the focus, avoid overcrowding.

PAGE: the 99 Names of Allah directory. Texture: a broad extremely faint sage/teal radial glow ONLY behind the centered heading, fading completely into plain ivory by the tile grid. Fine muted gold Islamic geometry confined to the upper outer corners. Smooth opaque cream tiles. No paper grain, mesh or grid texture.
LAYOUT: compact nav, centered large Arabic heading exactly "الأسماء الحسنى", serif heading "The 99 Names of Allah", quote exactly "And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them." and small teal citation "Al-A'raf 7:180".
Generous space, then toolbar "Explore the names" and pill search "Search by name, meaning or number".
Elegant 3-column by 4-row grid of TWELVE representative tiles. Each tile: small gold numbered ornament near top, large centered teal Arabic name, serif transliteration and smaller meaning. All tiles same quiet cream surface, subtle warm border, equal spacious layout.
Tile content EXACT:
1 | الرَّحْمَنُ | Ar-Rahman | The Beneficent
2 | الرَّحِيمُ | Ar-Raheem | The Merciful
3 | الْمَلِكُ | Al-Malik | The King / Eternal Lord
4 | الْقُدُّوسُ | Al-Quddus | The Purest
5 | السَّلاَمُ | As-Salam | The Source of Peace
6 | الْمُؤْمِنُ | Al-Mu'min | The Inspirer of Faith
7 | الْمُهَيْمِنُ | Al-Muhaymin | The Guardian
8 | الْعَزِيزُ | Al-Aziz | The Precious / The Most Mighty
9 | الْجَبَّارُ | Al-Jabbar | The Compeller
10 | الْمُتَكَبِّرُ | Al-Mutakabbir | The Greatest
11 | الْخَالِقُ | Al-Khaliq | The Creator
12 | الْبَارِئُ | Al-Bari' | The Maker of Order
Below grid small understated annotation "Collection preview · first 12 names" to clarify this illustration samples a longer directory. Footer. Small footer concept label "02 · Names directory · Sage glow". No giant decorative art or invented categories. Let calligraphic names lead.

PAGE: individual name Ar-Rahman. Texture: broad very faint champagne glow behind the top Arabic name, with a delicate hairline gold geometric frame around that hero region only. Glow fades into plain ivory below. No mesh or busy pattern. Smooth cream reading surfaces.
LAYOUT: centered editorial column about 900 pixels wide. Breadcrumb "Names of Allah / Ar-Rahman". Hero: small gold "NAME 1 OF 99", large beautiful Arabic "الرَّحْمَنُ", serif title "Ar-Rahman", smaller "The Beneficent". Short introduction exact "The name of overflowing mercy that holds every living thing". Below small paired controls "Root · ر ح م" and "In the Quran →".
Main reading panel: heading "A mercy so vast it reaches even those who reject Him", then well-spaced sections with thin gold separators. Use these exact snippets:
"Who He is as Ar-Rahman": "Ar-Rahman is the name of mercy at full flood. It is mercy that does not wait to be earned."
"Where you see His mercy": "A whole surah carries this name, and it is a tour of creation: the sun and moon, the sea and its pearls, the ships, the gift of speech."
"Handing your affairs to Him": "If Ar-Rahman is behind your life, then pain is not a sign that He has forgotten you."
"Why the heart loves Him": "We love those who were good to us before we could ask."
Champagne-tinted callout headed "CALL ON HIM" with exact text "Ya Rahman, Your mercy has covered me since the womb. Let me see it in what I have and in what I have lost, and make me merciful to others so that I may be shown mercy." Small label "Personal supplication".
Separate pale teal callout "TRY THIS TODAY" with exact text "Write down five things you have today that you did nothing to earn, and say alhamdulillah for each one slowly."
Then small section "Read it with" with two side-by-side restrained links "Ar-Raheem" and "Ar-Razzaq".
Closed FAQ disclosure "What is the difference between Ar-Rahman and Ar-Raheem?" and another "Explanation in Arabic". Small source note "Drawn from Asma al Husna and Ustadh Hisham Abu Yusuf's lessons · Draft".
Bottom navigation "All 99 names" and "Next · Ar-Raheem →". Footer. Small footer concept label "03 · Individual name · Champagne glow".
Fit all sections legibly with calm spacing. The Arabic name should dominate the opening, reading copy dominates below. No invented theological text or additional quotations.
